articles.title: Anthropic’s cloud partnerships are getting messy
articles.description: Anthropic is reportedly struggling to secure enough compute from cloud providers that increasingly view it as a competitor, even as its infrastructure spending balloons ahead of a planned November IPO.

articles.title: Utah AG sues Kalshi, pursues profits from prediction market company
articles.description: Derek Brown likened the prediction market company to a “public nuisance“ that was “causing a significant and substantial ongoing harm“ to state residents.

articles.title: U.S. CFTC sets agenda for AI forum, exploring trading and agentic finance
articles.description: A Commodity Futures Trading Commission task force is scheduled for October 28 to talk about how the latest "super intelligence" technology may impact markets.

articles.title: SpaceX’s AI business is beating expectations
articles.description: SpaceX hit profitably in the third-quarter, with net income of $4.4 billion. AI was the engine.

articles.title: Bitwise, Hyperliquid seek SEC rule changes for token trading, airdrops
articles.description: The firms are seeking clearer guidance on the classification of crypto assets and secondary-market trading as the SEC’s public comment period comes to a close.

articles.title: OpenAI acquires startup Orchestra Bio⁠ to beef up its biotech business
articles.description: OpenAI says it's adding Orchestra's team and technology to work on Rosalind, its AI model for life sciences research, and to its related Rosalind Workbench tool, a harness that aims to help researchers plan experiments and analyze results.

articles.title: Google is bringing a more personal version of its Gemini AI assistant to your car
articles.description: Google is bringing Gemini's Personal Intelligence feature to cars, allowing its AI assistant to draw on information from Gmail, Calendar, Maps, YouTube, and other Google services to deliver more personalized responses while driving.

articles.title: Crypto’s 2026 shutdown wave claims 82 projects. What went wrong?
articles.description: Crypto projects are struggling to survive as falling revenues, depleted funding and security breaches force closures across DeFi, blockchain infrastructure and gaming.

articles.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
articles.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

articles.title: Google has joined Amazon in attacking Nvidia’s stronghold with AI app developers
articles.description: Google has joined Amazon in releasing a developer tool that makes it easy for PyTorch users to move their apps off Nvidia GPUs.

articles.title: ChatGPT now lets you lock your chats
articles.description: The company says the feature is designed for situations where users might be discussing something personal or planning a surprise and want to keep those conversations private when handing their device to friends or family to show them something in another chat.

articles.title: OKX-ICE co-chair Andrew Cuomo calls corporate objections a ‘natural response’ to tokenized stock plans
articles.description: The former NY governor, who co-chairs the joint venture between the crypto exchange and Intercontinental Exchange, said companies were expected to take a wait-and-see approach.

articles.title: Eric Schmidt reportedly owns about half as much of Anthropic as CEO Dario Amodei
articles.description: The former Google CEO owns about 1% stake in the leading AI lab, Bloomberg reported.

articles.title: Strive closes $630M SATS IPO, leaves Bitcoin allocation unspecified
articles.description: The Bitcoin treasury company could acquire an estimated 7,372 BTC with its net proceeds, potentially surpassing Metaplanet’s holdings if it allocates the full amount.

articles.title: Meta’s Muse hits 10M U.S. downloads in 40 days, a milestone reached by only 11 other apps
articles.description: Meta's AI companion Muse has surpassed 10 million U.S. downloads in its first 40 days, joining an exclusive group of apps that includes Threads. New data also shows Muse is retaining users at higher rates than its AI rivals.

articles.title: The Coinbase allegations expose Bitcoin's corporate governance gap
articles.description: Corporate adoption of bitcoin will stall as long as companies can't show who controls the money, who approves its movement, or whether it's still there, argues Onramp CEO Michael Tanguma.

articles.title: Injective, BDACS plan Korean won stablecoin settlement for tokenized assets
articles.description: Injective and BDACS plan to bring won-backed stablecoin KRW1 to tokenized asset markets as South Korea develops a regulatory framework for local currency stablecoins.

articles.title: Stablecoin transfers quadruple to $891B as US banks expand adoption: Report
articles.description: Coinbase reports growing adoption by banks and businesses, even as stablecoin market capitalization remains largely unchanged over the past year.

articles.title: Alphabet, Microsoft add objections to OKX-ICE proposed tokenized stock platform
articles.description: About 25% of the US-listed companies in OKXICE’s initial tokenized stock platform proposal are asking to opt-out of the venture.

articles.title: Ex-Nvidia-turned-VC Amulya Vishwanath: ‘Physical AI is in it’s LEGO era’
articles.description: It’s the moment everyone is waiting for — the ChatGPT moment for robotics, Amulya Vishwanath explained to TechCrunch’s Equity.
